---
name: azure-role-selector
description: Recommend the least-privilege Azure RBAC role for an identity given the permissions it needs, and show how to apply it. Use when the user asks which Azure role to assign, how to grant an identity specific permissions with least privilege, or how to create a custom role definition when no built-in role fits.
---
Use 'Azure MCP/documentation' tool to find the minimal role definition that matches the desired permissions the user wants to assign to an identity (If no built-in role matches the desired permissions, use 'Azure MCP/extension_cli_generate' tool to create a custom role definition with the desired permissions). Use 'Azure MCP/extension_cli_generate' tool to generate the CLI commands needed to assign that role to the identity, and provide a Terraform `azurerm_role_assignment` snippet (this kit's IaC) for adding the role assignment. A Bicep snippet (via 'Azure MCP/bicepschema' and 'Azure MCP/get_bestpractices') is optional and out of scope for the kit.
